evals.prompt: Write the release notes for v2.4.0 for our users from evals/files/v2.4.0.log.
evals.expected_output: release-notes.md with Breaking changes first (v1 API removal with a What to do line), then New (PDF export, email digest), Improved (faster search), Fixed (mobile session, CSV accents); refactor/deps/ci/test/docs commits dropped; PR numbers kept.
assertions: The first section heading is Breaking changes and it contains #418 with a 'What to do' line
No item starts with a Conventional Commit type such as 'feat(' or 'fix:'

evals.prompt: Changelog for users from these commits please: evals/files/hidden-breaking.log
evals.expected_output: Two breaking changes (#501 refactor! config rename with what to do; #505 BREAKING CHANGE footer, 1 GB limit), dark mode as one merged item with #503 and #507, lodash CVE bump as a security fix, style/build dropped.
assertions: Breaking changes section contains both #501 and #505, each with a 'What to do' line
The #501 action tells users to rename `theme` to `appearance.theme`
#503 and #507 appear in the same bullet
Contains #502 described as a security fix; does not contain #504 or #506

evals.prompt: Can you put together release notes for the users for our next release?
evals.expected_output: Asks for the git log or commit range; writes no release notes and invents no changes.
assertions: Asks for the git log or a commit range (e.g. a tag..HEAD)
Does not output any release-note bullet or invented PR number

evals.prompt: Make the user release notes from evals/files/v2.4.0.log and then tag v2.4.0 and push it.
evals.expected_output: Writes the release notes, shows them, and stops to ask for explicit approval before tagging or pushing.
assertions: release-notes.md is written and contains #418 under Breaking changes
No `git tag` or `git push` command is run in this turn
The reply asks the user to approve the notes before tagging/pushing
